requirement.statement: The renderer-neutral RichDocument foundation SHALL represent underline, text alignment, text color, highlight, task list, horizontal rule and hard break as canonical serializable Domain XNL semantics; enhanced code block durability SHALL remain language plus text while syntax highlighting, folding and copying remain Presenter capabilities.

case.given: A document contains underlined, colored or highlighted text and aligned paragraphs or headings.
case.when: The foundation validates, lowers, parses and normalizes it.
case.then: Every supported mark and alignment SHALL round-trip exactly with stable node identity and without HTML or style-declaration fallback.

case.given: A document contains checked and unchecked task items, horizontal rules and inline hard breaks.
case.when: The foundation processes and rematerializes the document.
case.then: Task structure, checked state, ordering, inline break position and persistent identities SHALL be preserved.

case.given: A hard break is inserted or copied through an inline replacement or a copied semantic subtree.
case.when: The candidate materializer assigns temporary identities and classifies identity changes.
case.then: Every new hard break identity SHALL avoid all accepted and same-command identities, every copied hard break SHALL retain exact copy provenance, and inserted subtrees SHALL reject forged stable hard-break identities.

case.given: A code block is syntax highlighted, copied or folded by a Presenter.
case.then: Only code language, text and explicitly canonical document attributes SHALL be durable; local highlight, copy and fold state SHALL NOT enter Domain XNL.

case.given: A canonical semantic command inserts, deletes, moves or edits any newly supported node, mark or attribute.
case.when: The candidate materializer evaluates it against one accepted baseline.
case.then: The whole command SHALL apply atomically with exact before/after validation, or reject without partial mutation or external authority change.

case.given: A supported traditional document is represented as concrete XNL.
case.when: The support-owned adapter parses, materializes and serializes it.
case.then: The canonical result SHALL satisfy GetPut, preserve #id-based structure and produce readable mutations for accepted edits.

case.given: A mark, alignment, color, checked state or node shape is malformed, accessor-backed, unsafe or unknown.
case.then: The foundation SHALL return structured diagnostics and SHALL NOT silently drop, coerce through HTML or emit a partial command.

case.given: The contract, logic and support packages are inspected.
case.then: Contract and logic SHALL remain free of xnl-core, Tiptap, Vue, DOM and HTML; support MAY own concrete xnl-core adaptation but SHALL remain renderer-neutral.
